name: Guangdong Jiayuan Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Jiayuan Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of electrolytic copper foils in China. The company offers electronic circuit copper foil, lithium battery copper foil, and high-performance precision copper wire, as well as standard copper foil. Its products are primarily used in lithium-ion batteries, copper clad laminates, and printed circuit boards, as well as new energy vehicle power batteries, energy storage batteries, reverse treated foil, solid-state batteries, AI computing power, humanoid robots, multilayer circuit boards, and 3C digital electronic products.
